title: My Robot Friend
description: A boy builds a robot that helps him at home and at school.
instructions: Read the story about Minh and his robot. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🤖 Minh loves science. Last winter, he started to build a robot in his bedroom. It took him three months, because he worked on it only at weekends. He called his robot Beep.
Beep is about one metre tall and has a round blue head. It has two big eyes, which light up when it is happy. Beep can walk, talk and carry small things, but it can't swim.
Every morning, Beep wakes Minh up. It says, 'Good morning! It's seven o'clock!' Then it brings him a glass of water. Minh's mum thinks that Beep is better than an alarm clock.
One day, Minh took Beep to school for the science fair. The other children were very excited. Anna asked, 'Can your robot do my homework?' Minh laughed. 'No, Beep says you should do it yourself!'
During the fair, something went wrong. Beep stopped moving and its eyes went dark. 'Oh no! The battery is empty,' said Minh. He had forgotten to charge it the night before.
Fortunately, Mr Lee, the science teacher, had a charger in his office. After twenty minutes, Beep's eyes lit up again, and the fair continued. Minh felt very relieved.
At the end of the day, the judges gave Minh the first prize. 'Your robot is clever and friendly,' said one of them. Minh was so proud that he couldn't stop smiling.
Now Minh is planning to make a new robot that can help people at the hospital. 'If I work hard, I might finish it by next summer,' he says. Beep is going to help him, of course.
